BibleBack Translation

Ka Meupiya ne Panugtulen sumale ki

The Good Report according to

Huwan

John

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka migsulat te seini ne baseen, iyan si Huwan ne sabeka te sapulu wey daruwa (12) ne hibateen ni Hisus. Sikandin ka hibateen ne miggeyinawaan amana ni Hisus, wey suled din si Santiyagu ne hibateen ded degma ni Hisus. Te ware pad neyimu ne me hibateen ensi Huwan ki Santiyagu, mangngengalap pad sikandan diye te Lanew te Galiliya duma te amey ran ne si Sibidiyu. Te neyimu e sikandan ne me hibateen, layun sikandan egdumdumaa ni Hisus te me hipanawan din. Ka pegduma-ruma ni Huwan ki Hisus, sabeka ne pamalehet ne malehet iya ka nasulat te seini ne baseen.

The one who wrote this document (LIT reading), was Huwan who was one of the twelve (12) disciples of Jesus. He (was) the disciple who was much loved by Jesus, and Santiyagu was his sibling/cousin who was also a disciple of Jesus. Before Huwan and Santiyagu became disciples, they were fishermen at the lake of Galiliya together_with their father Sibidiyu. When they became disciples, they always accompanied Jesus on his journeys. Huwan's accompanying of Jesus, (it's) one of the evidences that what written in this document is really true.

Ka guhuren ni Huwan, diye migbunsud te pegpanengneng din ke nekey ka Lalag te Manama, ne neyimu e ne etew wey mig-ugpe e kayi te ampew te tane duma kanta. Nataman, nahuhud din e man-e ka meyitenged ki Huwan ne Talagbewutismu ne miggun-a miggendini ki Hisus eyew te peg-andam te keet-etawan te pegginguma ni Hisus.

The story of Huwan, (it) started there at his making_known what is the Word of God (MS Manama), which became a person and lived here on the top of the ground with us(incl). Then, he also storied about John the Baptizer who came_here before Hisus in_order to prep(are) the people for the arrival of Hisus.

Diye te kapitulu daruwa (2) peendiye te kapitulu sapulu wey daruwa (12) nasulat ka nalein-lein ne me kein-inuwan ne inggimu ni Hisus ne migpeila ne sikandin iya ka Kristu ne insaad te Manama ne egluwas te me Hudiyu, wey te langun ne kene ne me Hudiyu ne egpalintutuu wey egsalig kandin. Egkatahaan ta kayi ne due me etew ne migpalintutuu wey migsalig kandin wey neyimu ne me hibateen din, wey due degma miggubabe kandin.

In chapter two (2) through chapter twelve (12) are written the various wonders that Jesus did which showed that he's truly the Christ who was promised by God who will_save the Hudiyus, and all non Hudiyus who will_believe and trust in him. We(incl) will_find_out here that there were people who believed and trusted in him and became his disciples, and there were also ones_who_disbelieved him.

Diye te kapitulu sapulu wey tatelu (13) peendiye te kapitulu sapulu wey pitu (17), nasulat ka amana ne meupiya ne pegpaalukuyey enni Hisus te me hibateen din te ware pad dakepa sikandin. Impanpanayan din sikandan lalahi wey baggeta su natahaan din e ne mahaan e ka timpu ne iglansang e sikandin te krus.

In chapter thirteen (13) to seventeen (17), the very good friendship of Jesus and his disciples before he's arrested is written_about. He warned_ them _in_advance and encouraged (them) because he already knew that the time that he would_be_nailed to a cross was close.

Diye te katammanan ne me kapitulu, nahuhud ka pegdakep ki Hisus wey ka peggukum kandin, ka peglansang kandin diye te krus, ka pegkeuyag din, wey ka pegpakita rin te me hibateen din.

In the last chapters, the capturing of Jesus and judging of him are storied, the nailing of him on the cross, his resurrection, and the revealing of him to his disciples.

Impaay-ayaran degma ni Huwan te egpanengneng ne egkarawat ta ka dasag ne umul ne ware egtamanan pinaahi te pegpalintutuu wey pegsalig ta ki Hisu Kristu. Sikandin de ka dalan, ka kamalehetan, wey ka umul.

Huwan also clearly/carefully made_known that we(incl) can receive the gift life without ending by_means of our(incl) believing and trusting in Hisu Kristu. He's the only way/path, the truth, and the life.

Ka Lalag ne egbehey te umul

The Word that gives life

11 Te ware pad neyimu ne minsan nekey, duen e ka egngaranan te Lalag. Ka Lalag duma te Manama, wey iyan iya ka Manama. 2 Puun te an-anayan, ka Lalag dume e te Manama. 3 Neyimu ka langun pinaahi te Lalag, wey ware minsan sabeka ne neyimu ne kene ne pinaahi kandin. 4 Ne ka Lalag, iyan egpuunan te umul ne iyan miglayag te suman-suman te me etew. 5 Nakateng-ew te marusilem ka kalayag, wey ware seini nareeg te marusilem.

11 Before anything was_made, what_is_named the Word already was. The Word is/was with God, and it is/was indeed God. 2 From the beginning, the Word was with God. 3 Everything was_made by_means of the Word, and not even one_thing was_made that wasn't by_means of him. 4 And the Word, it is/was the source of life which illuminated the minds/thinking of people. 5 The light shined the night/darkness, and this was not defeated by the darkness/night.

6 [xr]Na, due etew ne insuhu te Manama ne egngaranan ki Huwan. 7 Migpamalehet sikandin diye te me etew meyitenged te kalayag, su eyew egpakapalintutuu ka langun pinaahi te pegpamalehet din. 8 Ne kene ne si Huwan ka kalayag, piru miggendini sikandin eyew egpamalehet meyitenged kayi. 9 Ne seini se malehet ne kalayag, iyan ka miggendini te kalibutan ne egteng-ew te langun ne etew.

6 [xr]Now_then, there_was a person sent/commanded by God named Huwan. 7 He confirmed to the people about the light, so_that everyone will_believe by_means of his confirming. 8 And Huwan wasn't the light, but he came_here to confirm it. 9 And this true light, it's what came to the world to shine on all the people.

10 Ne miggendini sikandin te kalibutan, ne minsan neyimu ka kalibutan pinaahi kandin, piru ware mig-ila kandin ka nangugpe kayi. 11 Miggendini sikandin te kandin ne inged, piru ka kandin ne keet-etawan ware migdawat kandin. 12 Piru minsan hentew-a ne migdawat wey migpalintutuu kandin, imbehayan din te katenged ne egkeyimu ne anak te Manama. 13 Ware sikandan neyimu ne me anak te Manama pinaahi te pegpewulirey te alunggun wey te pegbuut naa te etew, ke kene, pinaahi te pegbuut te Manama.

10 Then he came to the world, and although the world was_made by_means of him, yet those_who_lived in it did not recognize him. 11 He came_here to his place, but he wasn't accepted by his tribe. 12 But whoever accepted and believed him, he gave authority to become child of God. 13 They didn't become children of God by_means of the sexual_relations of a married_couple or by the desire/will of a person, but rather, by_means of the will of God.

14 Ne ka Lalag, neyimu ne etew wey miglemung mig-ugpe kanta. Amana sikandin ne meupiya wey hiid-uwen, wey malehet ka inlalag din. Nakita ney ka katelesan din, ka katelesan isip sabsabeka ne Anak te Manama ne Amey.

14 And the Word, (it) became a person and lived with us(incl). He is very good and merciful, and what_ he _says is true. We(excl) saw his splendor, the splendor as the one_and_only Child of God the Father.

15 Ne migpamalehet si Huwan meyitenged kandin, wey migpanguleyi ka migkahi, “Sikandin ka ingkahi ku ne egpakasinundul keddi. Ne labew sikandin keddiey, su duen e sikandin te ware e pad miglesut.”

15 And Huwan proved/witnessed about him, and loudly proclaimed, “He (is) the one I said that would follow me. And he is greater than I, because he existed before I was_born.”

16 Ne puun te dakel ne keupiya wey keyid-u rin, ware tamanan te pegpanalangin din kanta. 17 Ka Balaud imbehey te Manama kanta pinaahi ki Muwisis, piru pinaahi ki Hisu Kristu ne migginguma ka keupiya wey keyid-u, wey ka kamalehetan. 18 Ware minsan sabeka ne nakakita te Manama. Piru ka sabsabeka ne Anak te Manama ne layun duma te Amey rin, sikandin ka migpeila te Manama kanta.

16 And from his great goodness and mercy, there_is_no end to his blessing of us(incl). 17 The Law was_given to us(incl) by God through Muwisis, but through Jesus Christ that goodness and mercy, and the truth arrived. 18 There_is_not even one who has seen God. But the only_one Child of God who always accompany his Father, he is the (one who) has made God known to us(incl).

Ka guhuren ni Huwan ne Talagbewutismu

The story of Huwan the Baptizer

(Mat 3:1‑12; Mar 1:1‑8; Luk 3:1‑18)

(Mat 3:1‑12; Mar 1:1‑8; Luk 3:1‑18)

19 Due me talagpanubad wey me Libita[fn] ne insuhu te me pangulu te Hudiyu te Hirusalim ne egpeendiyeen ki Huwan su egpeinseen. Ne migkahi sikandan ka mig-inse, “Hentew kaa?”

19 There were some sacrificers and Libitas[fn] who were commanded by the leaders of the Hudiyus of Hirusalim to_go to Huwan in_order to ask (him). And they said in asking, “Who are you(sg)?”

20 Ne ware miggeeles si Huwan su migpangguhud sikandin te malehet ne migkahi, “Kene ne sikeddi ka Kristu.”[fn]

20 And Huwan didn't hide_something because he storied the truth and said, “I am not the Christ.”[fn]

21 [xra][xrb]Ne mig-inse e man-e sikandan kandin, “Hentew ke naan iya? Si Ilyas ka?”

21 [xra][xrb]And they asked him again, “Who are you(sg) really? Are you(sg) Ilyas?”

Ne migtabak si Huwan, “Kena a ne si Ilyas.”

And Huwan answered, “I am not Ilyas.”

Ne mig-inse e man-e sikandan, “Kema ke sikeykew ka Prupita ne egtetaharan ney?”

And they asked again, “Perhaps you(sg) (are) the Prophet that we(excl) are waiting_for?”

Ne migtabak e man-e si Huwan, “Kene ne sikeddiey.”

And Huwan answered again, “I am not.”

22 Seeye naa, migkahi sikandan, “Na, panugtuli key ke hentew kaa, su eyew due igkatabak ney te migsuhu kanami. Nekey-a ka igkalalag nu meyitenged te pegkeetew nu?”

22 And so, they said, “Now_then, tell us(excl) who you(sg) are, so_that we(excl) have an answer for those who commanded us(excl). What can you(sg) say about yourself?”

23 [xr]Ne migtabak si Huwan, “Sikeddiey ka egkahiyen ni prupita Isayas ne eggenendue:

23 [xr]And Huwan answered, “I (am) the (one who) is spoken about by prophet Isayas like_this:

‘Due egpanguleyi diye te disirtu ne egkahi,

‘There_is someone shouting in the desert who says,

Tul-ira niyu ka dalan te Magbebaye!’ ”

Straighten(pl) the path of the Lord!’ ”

24 Ne iyan migsuhu te seeye ne me etew ka me Parisiyu. 25 Ne mig-insaan dan e man-e si Huwan, “Ne mania te egpamewutismu ka te kene ke bes ne Kristu wey ke si Ilyas naa, wey ke ka Prupita?”

24 And the ones who sent/commanded those people were the Parisiyus. 25 And they asked Huwan again, “And why do you(sg) baptize when you(sg) are not (surprise) the Christ or Ilyas, or the Prophet?”

26 Ne migtabak si Huwan, “Egpamewutismu e re te weyig, piru due duma niyu kayi kuntee ne ware niyu neileyi. 27 Egpakasinundul sikandin keddiey, piru kena a ne likes ne eggekad te hiket te sandal din.”

26 And Huwan answered, “I just baptize with water, but there_is (someone) among you(pl) here now/today that you(pl) don't know. 27 He will_come_after me, but I am not worthy to untie the lace(s) of his sandal(s).”

28 Neyitabu seini diye te Bitanya, diye te deyipag te weyig ne egngaranan te Hurdan ne egpamewutismuwan ni Huwan.

28 This happened in Bitanya, on the bank of the river named Hurdan where Huwan baptized.

Ka migbayad te sale te me etew

The one who paid the sin of the people

29 Te seup ne aldew, nakita ni Huwan si Hisus ne eggendiye te kandin. Ne dutu, migkahi e si Huwan, “Pammineg kew, kayid e ka Nati ne Karniru te Manama ne eg-awe te me sale te me etew kayi te ampew te tane! 30 Sikandin ka egkahiyen ku ne egpakasinundul keddiey piru labew keddiey, su duen e sikandin te ware e pad ilesut. 31 Minsan sikeddi dengan, wara a nekeila ke hentew-a sikandin. Piru miggendini a ka egpamewutismu pinaahi te weyig su eyew egkeila sikandin te me kabuhalan ni Israil.

29 The next day, Huwan saw Jesus going to him. At that, Huwan said, “Listen(pl), the Young Sheep of God that removes the sins of the people on top of the ground is here! 30 He (is) the (one that) I said who will_ only _come_after me but is greater than me, because he existed before I was_born. 31 Even I before, I didn't recognize who he was. But I came_here to baptize by_means of water so_that he would_be_known by the descendants of Israil.

32 “Egpamalehet a ne nakita ku ka Panisingan te Manama ne miglene diye te kandin iling te seleppati puun diye te langit, wey migpalunggehaat seini diye te kandin. 33 Dengan, ware e pad nekeila ke hentew-a sikandin, piru ka Manama ne migsuhu keddi te pegpamewutismu pinaahi te weyig, tapey e migkahi keddi, ‘Ka etew ne egkakita nu ne eglenaan te Panisingan wey egpalunggehaat seini diye te kandin, sikandin naa ka egpamewutismu pinaahi te Panisingan.’ 34 Ne nakita kud en iya sika kuntee, sikan naa ka egpamalehet a te sikandin iya ka Anak te Manama.”

32 “I will_prove/witness that I saw the Spirit of God descend to him like a dove from the sky/heaven, and it remained on him. 33 Before, I didn't know who he was, but God who commanded me to baptize by_means of water, already told me, ‘The person on whom you(sg) see the Spirit descend and it remains on him, he is the (one who) will_baptize by_means of the Spirit.’ 34 And I saw it now/today, that's why I will_prove/witness to you(pl) that he is really the Offspring of God.”

Ka an-anayan ne me hibateen ni Hisus

The first disciples of Jesus

35 Te seup ne aldew, diyad e man-e si Huwan duma te daruwa ne hibateen din. 36 Ne nakita ni Huwan si Hisus ka eglihad, wey migkahi sikandin, “Seinid e ka Nati ne Karniru te Manama!”

35 The next day, Huwan was there again along_with two of his disciples. 36 And Huwan saw Jesus passing, and he said, “The Sheep Lamb of God is here!”

37 Ne seeye se daruwa ne hibateen din nakarineg te ingkahi rin wey migsinundul e sikandan ki Hisus. 38 Te peglilingey ni Hisus, nakita rin sikandan ka egsinundul kandin. Ne mig-insaan din e sikandan, “Nekey-a ka egpammitawen niyu?”

37 And those two disciples of him heard what he said and they followed Jesus. 38 When Jesus turned_his_head, he saw them following him. He asked them, “What are you(pl) looking for?”

Ne migtabak sikandan, “Rabi, hendei kaa mig-ugpe?” (Ka kaluwasan te Rabi, Talagpanulu.)

And they replied, “Rabi, where do you(sg) live?” (The meaning of the word Rabi, (is) Teacher.)

39 Ne migkahi si Hisus, “Kema, duma kew keddi eyew egkiteen niyu.” Purisu migdume e sikandan wey nakita ran e ka in-ugpaan din, wey migpalunggehaat sikandan duma kandin su me alas kuwatru\f + \fr 1:39 \ft Te Grigu: mahaan e ka igkasapulu ne uras.\f* e seeye te maapun.

39 And Jesus said, “Come, accompany(pl) me so_that you(pl) will_see (it).” Therefore they accompanied (him) and they saw his living_place, and they remained with him because it was about four\f + \fr 1:39 \ft In Greek: the tenth hour is close.\f* o'clock in the afternoon.

40 Si Andris ne suled ni Simun Pidru ka sabeka te seeye se daruwa ne nakarineg te ingkahi ni Huwan wey ka migsinundul ki Hisus. 41 Migweil-weil si Andris, impamitew rin ka suled din ne si Simun Pidru wey ingkahiyan, “Nakita ney e ka Misiyas.” (Ka kaluwasan te Misiyas, Kristu.[fn]) 42 Ne induma rin e si Simun diye te ki Hisus.

40 Andris the brother/cousin of Simun Pidru was the one of the two who heard what Huwan said and followed Jesus. 41 And what did Andris did, he searched for his brother/cousin Simun Pidru and said (to him), “We(excl) have found the Messiah.” (The word Messiah, it means Christ.[fn]) 42 And he took Simun to Jesus.

Te pegginguma ran diye te ki Hisus, migmemetmetan sikandin ni Hisus wey migkahiyan, “Sikeykew si Simun ne anak ni Huwan. Piru puun kuntee, egngaranan kad e ki Sipas.” (Ka Sipas iling ded ka kaluwasan te Pidru ne iyan igpasabut se, “batu.”)

When they arrived at Jesus, he was looked_closely at by Jesus and said, “You(sg) are Simun the child of Huwan. But from now/today, you(sg) will_be_called Sipas.” (Sipas is the same meaning with Pidru which means, “stone/rock.”)

Ka peg-umew ni Hisus engki Pilipi ki Natanail

The calling of Jesus with Pilipi and Natanail

43 Te seup ne aldew, nakasuman-suman si Hisus ne eggendiye te Galiliya. Ne nalambag din si Pilipi diye wey migkahiyan din, “Ikul ka keddiey.” 44 (Si Pilipi, matig-Bitsayda. Ne diye degma te sikan siyudad nangugpe ensi Andris wey Pidru.) 45 Nataman, nakita ni Pilipi si Natanail wey migkahiyan din, “Nakita ney e ka etew ne nasulat diye te Balaud ni Muwisis wey nasulat ded degma te me prupita. Sikandin bes si Hisus ne matig-Nasarit ne anak ni Husi.”

43 The next day, Jesus thought/planned to go to Galiliya. And he met Pilipi there and said to him, “Follow(sg) me.” 44 (Pilipi, was from_Bitsayda. In that city also where Andris and Pidru lived.) 45 Then, Pilipi saw Natanail and said to him, “We(excl) have found the person that was_written in Muwisis Law and that was also written by the prophets. He is Jesus from_Nasarit the child of Husi.”

46 Ne mig-insaan sikandin ni Natanail, “Duen bes ded meupiya ne etew ne matig-Nasarit?”

46 And Natanail asked him, “Is there good person from Nasarit?”

Ne migtabak si Pilipi, “Kema, egparumeey ki eyew egkakita nu.”

And Pilipi answered, “Come, we(excl) will_go_together so_that you(sg) will_see (him).”

47 Te pegkakita ni Hisus te egparani e si Natanail diye te kandin, migkahi e sikandin, “Te, seinid e ka malehet ne kabuhalan ni Israil, wey kene mule sikandin egpanlimbung.”

47 When Jesus saw the Natanail was approaching him, he said, “Oh, the true descendant of Israil is here, and he do not cheat.”

48 Ne mig-inse si Natanail, “Immenu nu te eg-ila keddiey?”

48 And Natanail asked like_this, “How do you(sg) know me?”

Ne migtabak si Hisus, “Te ware ke pad umawa ni Pilipi, nakita kud e sikeykew diye te lebut te kayu ne egngaranan te iggira.”

And Jesus answered, “Before Pilipi called you(sg), I saw you(sg) at the base of a tree named fig.”

49 Ne migkahi si Natanail, “Talagpanulu, sikeykew bes iya ka Anak te Manama! Sikeykew bes iya ka Hari te Israil!”

49 And Natanail said, “Teacher, you(sg) are indeed the Child of God! You(sg) really (are) the king of Israil!”

50 Ne migtabak si Hisus, “Kema ke migpalintutuu ke re puun te ingkahi ku ne nakita ku sikeykew diye te lebut te kayu? Subla pad kangkuwa due ka egkakita nu.” 51 [xr]Ne migkahiyan ni Hisus sikandan langun, “Egnangenan ku sikaniyu te malehet: egkakita niyu ka langit ne egkalukatan wey ka me panalihan te Manama ne egpamaneug wey egpamaneyik diye te Anak te Etew.”

50 And Jesus answered, “Perhaps you(sg) only believe as_a_result of what_ I _said that I saw you(sg) at the base of the tree? You(sg) will_see_things greater than that later.” 51 [xr]And Jesus said to them all, “I tell you(pl) the truth: you(pl) will_see the sky/heaven open and the angels of God descend and ascend on the Offspring of a Person.”

Ka kasal diye te Kana

The wedding at Kana

21 Te peglihad e te daruwa ne aldew, due kasal diye te lungsud te Kana ne sakup te Galiliya. Ne migtambung ka iney ni Hisus, 2 wey inninggat degma ensi Hisus duma te me hibateen din. 3 Te naamin e ka eg-inumen ne binu, migkahiyan e si Hisus te iney rin, “Naaminan e sikandan te binu.”

21 After two days had passed, there_was a wedding in the town of Kana under_the_jurisdiction of Galiliya. And the mother of Jesus attended, 2 and Jesus and his disciples were also invited. 3 When the wine drink was all_gone, Jesus was spoken to by his mother, “They've run out of wine.”

4 Ne migtabak si Hisus, “Ine, kena a banasali su ware pad migginguma ka keddi ne timpu.”

4 And Jesus answered, “Mom, don't urge me because my time doesn't arrive yet.”

5 Nataman, migkahiyan e te iney ni Hisus ka me suluhuanen, “Himuwa niyu ka minsan nekey ne igsuhu din kaniyu.”

5 Then, the mother of Jesus spoke to the servants, “Do(pl) whatever he commands you(pl).”

6 Ne due tuluuwen te me Hudiyu meyitenged te peg-ayad-ayad pegpanlu-lu. Sikan naa ka due hen-em diye ne banga ne batu ne egkatahuan ka tagse sabeka te daruwa ne pulu (20) peendiye te tatelu ne pulu (30) ne gelun ne weyig. 7 Ne migkahiyan ni Hisus ka me suluhuanen, “Hipenua niyu te weyig ka hen-em ne banga.” Ne miggipenu dan en iya seeye. 8 Nataman, migkahiyan e man-e sikandan ni Hisus, “Na, sakug kew naan e due te weyig wey uyana niyu diye te migpangulu te seini ne sahakeen.” Ne intuman dan iya seeye. 9 Ne miggeraman e degma te migpangulu te kasal ka weyig ne neyimu ne binu, piru ware sikandin nakanengneng ke hendei migpuun ka binu. (Piru nakanengneng e ka me suluhuanen ne migsakug te weyig.) Seeye naa, impeumew rin e ka egpangasawa 10 wey migkahiyan, “Nabatasan te kasuluhan ne iyan iggun-a igsendad ka subla ne mananam ne binu ne igpeinum te me mahaliyug. Ne emun ke dakel e ka egkeinum dan, henduen pad ka kene amana ne meupiya ne binu. Piru sikeykew mule, kunteen nud e ipalihawang ka subla ne mananam ne binu!”

6 And there_was a practice/belief of the Hudiyus about washing carefully/well. Thus there were six jars there which each jar could take twenty (20) to thirty (30) gallon_containers of water. 7 And Jesus said to the servants, “Fill(pl) the six jars with water.” And they filled them. 8 Then, Jesus said again, “Now_then, dip(pl) out that water and take(pl) it to the one leading this feast.” And they obeyed (that). 9 And the one leading the wedding tried the water that had become wine, but he didn't know where the wine had come from. (But the servants who dipped_out the water knew.) And from that, he called the bridegroom 10 and said, “It's the custom of most that the very nice_tasting wine is served first for the guests to drink. And when they have drunk lots, then the not so good wine. But you(sg) on_the_other hand, you(sg) have brought_out just now the extremely nice_tasting wine!”

27 Ne dutu, nakalibed e degma ka me hibateen ni Hisus. Ne neinu-inu sikandan te nakita ran sikandin ne migpakiglalag te malitan. Piru ware sabeka kandan ne egpekeinse te malitan ke nekey ka igkeupii rin, wey ware degma egpekeinse ki Hisus ke mania te migpakiglalag sikandin te malitan.

27 And then, the disciples of Jesus also returned. And they were surprised when they saw that he was talking with a woman. But not one of them asked the woman what she wanted, and also no_(one) asked Jesus why he was talking to a woman.

28 Seeye naa, mig-engkeran e te malitan ka banga din te miglibed diye te lungsud wey migkahiyan din ka me etew, 29 “Kema, mahaan kew, wey tengtengi niyu ka etew ne migpanugtul keddi te langun ne neyimu ku. Sikandin buwad ka Kristu?” 30 Ne nangawe ka me etew diye te lungsud wey nangendiye te ki Hisus.

28 And so, the woman left her water_jar to return to the town and told the people, 29 “Now_then, hurry(pl), and see(pl) the person who told me everything I had done. Maybe he is the Christ?” 30 And the people left the town and went_there to Jesus.

31 Taheed te egpalinggumaan pad ka me etew, imbanasalan si Hisus te me hibateen din ne migkahi, “Talagpanulu, keen ke pa.”

31 While the people were_ still _approaching, his disciples urged Jesus and said, “Teacher, eat(sg).”

32 Piru migkahi si Hisus, “Due egkakeen ku ne ware niyu nanengnengi.”

32 But Jesus said, “I have food that you(pl) don't know about.”

33 Seeye naa, migmein-inseey ka me hibateen din ne migkahi, “Duen buwa migdulung kandin te egkakeen?”

33 And so, the disciples asked_each_other and said, “Maybe someone brought food to him?”

34 Ne migkahiyan sikandan ni Hisus, “Ka egkakeen ku, iyan sika se pegtuman te igkeupii te migsuhu keddiey, wey te peg-impus te himu ne impeyimu keddi. 35 Due epad niyu ne eggenendue, ‘Eggingumaan pad te hep-at ne bulan human ka tinggaani.’ Piru egnangenan ku sikaniyu, tinggaani e kuntee. Pitawa niyu ka me pinamula diye te me kamet ne neyinuhan e wey eleg e ne eggaaniyen! 36 Ka eggaani, egbayaran sikandin, wey seeye se egkahaani, eglimuren wey egbehayan te umul ne ware egtamanan. Purisu, egkahale seeye se migpamula duma te seeye se miggaani. 37 Malehet iya ka eparen ne eggenendue, ‘Lein ne etew ka egpamula wey lein ne etew ka eggaani.’ 38 Impeyipanew ku sikaniyu eyew eggaani te ware niyu ikalasey te pegpamula. Nalasey ka me duma piru meupiya kew su sikaniyu ka nasunged puun te kandan ne himu.”

34 And Jesus said to them, “My food, it is obeying the desire of the (one who) sent/commanded me, and finishing the work that I was_given_to_do. 35 You(pl) have a saying that goes_like_this, ‘There will yet be (LIT arrive) four months until harvest_time.’ But I tell you(pl), (it is) harvest_time now. Look(pl) at the crops in the fields which are already ripe and correct to be harvested! 36 The harvester, he is paid, and that which he harvests, (it) is gathered and given life without ending. Therefore, those who plant along_with those who harvest will_be_happy. 37 The saying is indeed true that goes, ‘A different person is the planter and a different person is the harvester.’ 38 I sent you(pl) to harvest what you(pl) didn't work_hard to planting. Others worked_hard but you(pl) are good/well_off because you(pl) benefitted from their work.”

39 Masalig ka matig-Samarya ne migpalintutuu ki Hisus puun te migpanugtulan sikandan te malitan te nanengnengan ni Hisus ka langun ne neyimu rin. 40 Te pegginguma te me matig-Samarya diye te ki Hisus, inhangyu dan sikandin ke egkaayun ne eggirehe pad sikandin diye te kandan. Purisu, miggirehe pad iya si Hisus diye seled te daruwa ne aldew.

39 Many from Samarya believed Jesus since they were_told by the woman that Jesus knew all she had done. 40 When those from Samarya got to Jesus, they requested him if it was possible to stay_overnight there at their_place. Therefore, Jesus stayed there for two days.

41 Ne migmasalig pad man-e ka migpalintutuu kandin tenged te pegpanulu din. 42 Ne migkahiyan te me etew ka malitan, “Kuntee, migpalintutuu key e kandin, kene ne puun de te impangguhud nu kanami, ke kene, puun te sikanami en iya ka nakarineg kandin. Ne natahaan ney e ne sikandin bes iya ka Manluluwas te me etew kayi te ampew te tane.”

41 And many more believed him from his teaching. 42 And the people told the woman, “Now/Today, we(excl) believe him, not just from what you(sg) storied to us(excl), but rather, indeed from what we(excl) have heard from him. And we(excl) know that he really is the Savior of the people here on top of the ground.”

Ka pegbawi ni Hisus te anak te upisyal

The healing of Jesus with the child of the official

43 Te nararuan e ensi Hisus diye, mig-awe e sikandan dutu wey miggendiyad e te Galiliya. 44 [xr](Ne si Hisus mismu ka migkahi ne kene egtahuren ka prupita diye te inged ne intulinan din.) 45 [xr]Te pegginguma rin diye te Galiliya, meupiya ka pegsagsahipe kandin te me etew. Su nekeendiye ma sikandan te Hirusalim te timpu te Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan te Manama wey nakakita degma sikandan langun te immangimu ni Hisus diye.

43 When Jesus and_company had spent_two_days (LIT two_dayed) there, they left there and went_there to Galiliya. 44 [xr](And Jesus himself said that a/the prophet is not respected in the place where_ he _grew_up.) 45 [xr]When he arrived in Galiliya, the welcome of him by the people was good. For they had gone to Hirusalim during the time of the Feast of the Passing of the Angel of God and they had_seen everything that Jesus had done there.

46 [xr]Ne miglibed e man-e si Hisus diye te Kana ne sakup te Galiliya, ka inged ne miggimuwan din te binu puun te weyig. Ne dutu, due sabeka ne upisyal te gubirnu ne migdaluwan te anak din ne lukes diye te Kapirnaum. 47 Te pegkarineg din ne miglibed si Hisus diye te Galiliya puun te Hudiya, migdagdahew sikandin miggendiye te ki Hisus ne migpeyid-u-hid-u kandin ne eggendiye te Kapirnaum eyew egbawian ka anak din ne egkabigtawan e. 48 Migkahiyan sikandin ni Hisus, “Wey kew re egpalintutuu keddi ke egpakakita kew te me palinneu wey me kein-inuwan ne himu.”

46 [xr]Jesus returned again to Kana which was under_the_jurisdiction of Galiliya, the place where he had made wine from water. And there, there_was a government official whose male child was sick in Kapirnaum. 47 When he heard that Jesus had returned to Galiliya from Hudiya, he quickly went to Jesus and pleaded_with him to go to Kapirnaum to heal his child who was almost_dead. 48 Jesus said to him, “You(pl) only believe me if you(pl) see signs and miracles done.”

49 Piru migtabak ka upisyal, “Ahalen, duma ke pa ubag keddi te kene pad egkabigtawan ka anak ku.”

49 But the official answered, “Master, please come(sg) with me before my child dies.”

50 Ne migtabak si Hisus kandin, “Uli kad e su egkeulian e ka anak nu.”

50 And Jesus answered him again, “Go(sg)_home because your(sg) child will_recover.”

Migpalintutuu ka upisyal te inlalag ni Hisus diye te kandin, ne sikan de ne mig-uli e sikandin.51 Te egpatiralan pad sikandin, insinug-ung e sikandin te me suluhuanen din wey migpangguhuran, “Manekal e ka anak nu.”

The official believed what Jesus said to him, and immediately he went_home.51 While he was still on the road/path, he met his servants and was_told, “Your(sg) child is already healthy/alive.”

52 Ne mig-inse sikandin ke nekey ne uras ne migkabaluan ka anak din. Ne migtabak ka me suluhuanen, “Inlibuwanan e sikandin gabii te me ala una[fn] te maapun.” 53 Ne nasuman-suman te upisyal ne seeye iyan urasa ka pegkahi ni Hisus te egkeulian e ka anak din. Purisu, migpalintutuu sikandan langun se taltalaanak ki Hisus.

52 And the father asked what hour that his child improved. And the servants answered, “He lost_his_fever yesterday at about one o'clock[fn] in the afternoon.” 53 And the official remembered that it was at that hour/time that Jesus said his child would recover. Therefore, the whole family (of him) believed Jesus.

54 Sika ka igkarangeb ne kein-inuwan ne inggimu ni Hisus te pegginguma rin diye te Galiliya puun te Hudiya.

54 That was the second wonder done by Jesus upon his arriving there in Galiliya from Hudiya.

Ka pegbawi ni Hisus te etew ne diye te lanew

The healing of Jesus with the person at the lake

51 Te pegkapenga dutu, migtakereg e man-e si Hisus te Hirusalim eyew te pegtambung te sahakeen te me Hudiyu. 2 Ne diye te Hirusalim, due gumawan ne bayaanan te me karniru. Ne due lanew ne marani te seeye ne gumawan ne ingngaranan te me Hudiyu te Bitsata. Due lalimma ne helunganan ne nakaalingkus te lanew 3 ne impangibatan te susuluhi ne egmanderalu, me butud, me pungku, wey kene egkengaweil se lawa ne me etew.[fn] 5 Ne due sabeka ne etew diye ne tatelu ne pulu wey walu (38) e ne leg-un ka migderalu. 6 Nakita ni Hisus ka etew ne miggibat diye wey nanengnengan din e degma ka kaluhey te pegderalu rin. Seeye naa, mig-insaan din e ka etew, “Egkeupian ka ne egkeulian?”

51 When that was_finished, Jesus went_up again to Hirusalim to attend the feast of the Hudiyus. 2 Now in Hirusalim, there_was a doorway where sheep passed through. And there_was a lake near to that doorway that was called Bitsata by the Hudiyus. There were five shelter_places around the lake 3 where the very great_many sick people, blind, crippled, and the people whose body can't move laid.[fn] 5 And there_was a man who had been_sick for thirty-eight (38) years. 6 Jesus saw the man lying there and he also knew the length_(of_time) of his sickness. So then, he asked the person, “Do you(sg) want to be healed?”

7 Ne migtabak ka egderalu, “Ahalen, egkeupian a perem piru ware etew ne egpaseneb keddi due te weyig ke egkalihew e sika te panalihan, su emun ke egpeenduen ad e te weyig, duen e egpekewun-a keddiey.”

7 And the sick (one) replied, “Master, I want to but there's_no one to dip me into the water when it is moved by the angel, because while I am going_to the water, someone is always ahead of me.”

8 Ne migkahiyan sikandin ni Hisus, “Enew ka, wey uyana nu ka hibatanan nu wey hipanew kad.” 9 Sahuhune ne neulian ka etew te dalu rin, wey insabilbil din e ka hibatanan din wey miggipanew e.

8 And Jesus said to him, “Get(sg) up, and take your(sg) bedding and walk.” 9 Immediately the person was healed of his sickness, and he walked taking his bedding.

Neyitabu seeye te Aldew te Peggimeley.10 [xr]Purisu migkahiyan te me pangulu te me Hudiyu ka lukes ne neulian, “Mania te mig-uyan ka te hibatanan nu te Aldew kuntee te Peggimeley? Supak seini te Balaud ta.”

This happened on the Day of Resting.10 [xr]Therefore the leaders of the Hudiyus said to the man that was healed, “Why are you(sg) carrying your(sg) bedding when today is the Day of Resting? This is against our(incl) Law.”

11 Ne migtabak ka etew, “Ka migbawi keddi ka migsuhu ne igpeuyan ka hibatanan ku wey egpeyipanawen a.”

11 And the person answered, “The one who healed me commanded (me) to take my bedding and walk.”

12 Seeye naa, mig-insaan dan ka etew ke hentew ka migsuhu kandin te peg-uyan te hibatanan din wey te pegpeyipanew kandin.

12 And so, they asked the person who it was who had commanded him to take his bedding and to go.

13 Piru ware neileyi te etew ke hentew ka migbawi kandin, su nakasewug-sewug man-e si Hisus te susuluhi ne me etew.

13 But the person didn't know the (one who) had healed him, because Jesus was mixed to the great_many people.

14 Nataman, nakite e man-e ni Hisus diye te timplu ka etew ne imbawian din wey migkahiyan din, “Tengtengi nu naa te neulian kad en iya. Kene kad himu te sale su kema ke subla pad ne mareet ka egkeyitabu keykew.”

14 Afterwards, Jesus saw again in the temple the person he had healed and said to him, “Look(sg) you(sg) are really healed. Don't sin or even worse will_happen to you(sg).”

15 Nataman, mig-awe e ka etew ne migpangguhud te me pangulu te me Hudiyu ne si Hisus bes ka migbawi kandin. 16 Ne puun dutu, migbunsuran e te me pangulu te me Hudiyu si Hisus te egbayad-bayad tenged su migpamawi sikandin te Aldew te Peggimeley. 17 Ne migkahiyan sikandan ni Hisus, “Kene eg-engked ka Amey ku ne eggimu, sikan naa ka kena a degma eg-engked.”

15 Then, the person left and told the leaders of the Hudiyus that it was Jesus who healed him. 16 And from that, the leaders of the Hudiyus began to persecute Jesus since he healed on the Day of Resting. 17 And Jesus said to them, “My Father doesn't stop working, that's why I don't stop also.”

18 Puun te ingkahi ni Hisus, nanasnasian de iya nalelehet ka me pangulu te me Hudiyu ne eggimatey kandin, su kene ne iyan de egpuunan ka pegsupak din te Balaud meyitenged te Aldew te Peggimeley, ke kene, migkahi pad man-e sikandin te ka Manama iyan iya ka Amey rin. Iyan kaluwasan due ne nekeiling sikandin te Manama.

18 Because of what Jesus said, the leaders of the Hudiyus became more eager to kill him, because his disobeying of the Law concerning the Day of rest was not the only reason, but rather, he also said that God was indeed his Father. That means he was acting_like God.

Ka geem te Anak te Manama

The power of the Offspring of God

19 Purisu migkahi si Hisus diye te kandan, “Egnangenan ku sikaniyu te malehet: ware egkeyimu te Anak ke sikandin de. Eggimu re sikandin ke nekey ka nakita rin ne eggimuwen te Amey rin. Ke nekey ka eggimuwen te Amey, iling ded degma ka eggimuwen te Anak. 20 Miggeyinawaan amana te Amey ka Anak din wey impakita rin kandin ka langun ne eggimuwen din. Igpakita rin pad man-e diye te Anak din ka subla pad kayi ne me kein-inuwan, ne sika ka egpakapeinu-inu kaniyu. 21 Eg-uyahen te Amey ka me minatey wey egbehayan te umul, ne egbehey red degma ka Anak te umul te seeye se igkeupii rin ne eg-uyahen. 22 Kene eggukum ka Amey te minsan hentew, su imbehey rin diye te Anak din ka katenged te peggukum, 23 su eyew egtahud ka langun te Anak iling te pegtahud dan te Amey. Purisu, ka kene egtahud te Anak, kene degma egtahud te Amey ne migsuhu kandin.

19 Therefore Jesus said to them, “I tell you(pl) the truth: the Child can't do anything if it's just him. He does what he sees his Father do. Whatever the Father does, so also the Child does. 20 The Father greatly loves his Offspring and shows him all that he does. The Father will_ also _show to his Offspring much greater wonders than this/these, and that will_amaze you(pl). 21 The Father raises the dead and gives life, so the Child also will_give life to those who he wants to raise. 22 The Father doesn't judge anybody, because he gave the Child the authority to judge, 23 so_that everyone will_respect the Child like their respect for the Father. Therefore, the (one who) doesn't respect the Child, also doesn't respect the Father who sent/commanded him.

24 “Egnangenan ku sikaniyu te malehet: ka egpammineg te iglalag ku wey egpalintutuu te migsuhu keddiey, due umul ne ware egtamanan. Kenad sikandin eggukuman ne eglegparan tenged su nakabaye e sikandin puun te kamatayen peendiye te umul. 25 Egnangenan ku sikaniyu te malehet: egginguma ka timpu, ne ka seinid en iya kuntee, ne egdineg ka me minatey te laheng te Anak te Manama, ne seeye se egpakarineg, egkeuyag. 26 Ka Amey ka egpakabehey te umul, ne iling ded degma ka Anak din su imbehayan din te katenged te pegbehey te umul. 27 Migbehayan din man-e ka Anak te katenged te peggukum, tenged su Anak ma sikandin te Etew. 28 Kene kew keinu-inu kayi su egginguma ka timpu ne egpakarineg te laheng din ka langun ne me minatey diye te lebenganan, 29 [xr]wey egmanlihawang sikandan. Ka seeye se meupiya se neyimu, eg-uyahen wey egbehayan te umul ne ware egtamanan. Ka seeye se mareet se neyimu, eg-uyahen ded degma piru eggukuman ne eglegparan.”

24 “I tell you(pl) the truth: the (one who) listens to what_ I _say and believes/obeys the (one who) sent/commanded me, has life without ending. He/She won't be judged to be_punished since he has passed from death into life. 25 I tell you(pl) the truth: the time will_come, the (time) here now/today, when the dead will_hear the voice of the Child of God, and those who hear, will_live. 26 The Father is able_to_give life, and likewise also his Offspring because he gave him authority to give life. 27 He also gave the Child authority to judge, since he is the Child of a Person. 28 Don't(pl) be surprised at this because the time will_come when all the dead in their graves will_hear his voice, 29 [xr]and they will_come_out. Those who have done good, will_be_raised and given life without ending. Those who have done evil, will_be_raised also but judged to be_punished.”

Ka migpamalehet meyitenged ki Hisus

The proof/testimony about Jesus

30 Mig-abey pad man-e migkahi si Hisus, “Ware egkeyimu ku ke sikeddiey re. Su minsan eggukum a, piru iyan ku eg-ikulen ka iglalag te Manama keddi. Purisu matareng ka peggukum ku su kene e ma eggimu te igkeupii ku, ke kene, seeye de se igkeupii te migsuhu keddiey.

30 Jesus continued speaking, “I can do nothing if it's just me. Because even I judge, but I follow what God tells me. Therefore my judging is righteous because I don't do what_ I _want, but rather, just what the (one who) sent/commanded me wants.

31 “Emun ke sikeddiey re ka egpamalehet meyitenged te pegkeetew ku, kene seini egkapalintutuuwan. 32 Piru due duma ne migpamalehet meyitenged keddiey, wey nakanengneng a ne malehet ka ingkahi rin meyitenged keddi. 33 [xr]Due insuhu niyu diye te ki Huwan eyew te peg-inse-inse kandin, wey migpangguhud sikandin te malehet meyitenged keddi. 34 Kena a egkeilangan te pegpamalehet te me etew meyitenged keddiey, piru miglalag ku re sika eyew egpalintutuu kew wey egkaluwas kew. 35 Nekeiling si Huwan te impareketan ne sulu ne miglayag. Ne ingkahale niyu ka peglayag din minsan te malepet de ne timpu. 36 Piru due egpamalehet meyitenged keddiey ne subla pad te pegpamalehet ni Huwan. Su ka immangimu ku ne igmeyimu iya te Amey ku keddiey, iyan sika ka migpamalehet te impeendini a iya te Amey ku. 37 [xr]Ne ka Amey ne migpeendini keddiey iyan iya migpamalehet meyitenged keddi. Piru ware kew en iya nakakita te ulaula rin wey ke nakarineg naa te laheng din, 38 wey warad iya nakapamula te pusung niyu ka lalag din, su ware kew migpalintutuu keddi te impeendini rin. 39 In-ugsi-ugsi niyu ka Kasulatan su kahiyen niyu ne sika ka paahi ne egpakaangken kew te umul ne ware egtamanan. Ne ka Kasulatan, migpamalehet iya meyitenged keddiey 40 piru ware kew red iya man-e migparani keddiey eyew egpakaangken te umul ne ware egtamanan.

31 “If I just testify about myself, this can't be believed. 32 But there_is another who testifies about me, and I know that what he says is true about me. 33 [xr]You(pl) commanded someone to go to Huwan to ask him, and he told the truth about me. 34 I don't need for people to testify about me, but I said that so_that you(pl) will_believe and be_saved. 35 Huwan was like a lamp that was_on and shines. And you(pl) enjoyed his shining even just for a short time. 36 But there_is someone/something who will_testify about me which greater than of Huwan's. Because the things I did which my Father asked_me_to_do, that testify that I was really sent/commanded by my Father. 37 [xr]And the Father who sent_ me _here (he) himself testifies about me. But you(pl) haven't seen his face or heard his voice, 38 and his word is not planted in your(pl) hearts, because you(pl) didn't believe me whom he sent_here. 39 You(pl) studied_ the Scripture(s) _carefully because you(pl) think_(wrongly) that it's the way you(pl) will_receive life without ending. And the Scripture(s), (it) testifies about me 40 but still you(pl) didn't approach me in_order_to receive life.

41 “Kena a egparayan-dayan te me etew. 42 Piru neilaan ku mule sikaniyu wey nanengnengan ku ne ware diye te pusung niyu ka geyinawa te Manama. 43 Miggendini a ka mig-uyan te katenged te Amey ku, piru wara a nikaniyu dawata. Ne ke due lein ne eggendini te kandin de ne katenged, iyan niyu nasi egdawaten. 44 Egmenuwen niyu te pegpalintutuu ke iyan niyu re igkeupii ne egmekegdayan kew, piru egbalaharen niyu ka pegdayan ne egpuun te sabsabeka ne Manama. 45 Piru kene kew egsuman-suman ne sikeddi ka egsumbung kaniyu diye te Amey ku. Si Muwisis iya ne migpallatengan niyu ka egsumbung kaniyu. 46 Ke malehet ne migpalintutuu kew ki Muwisis, egpalintutuu kew perem degma keddiey su sikandin iya ka migsulat meyitenged keddi. 47 Piru tenged su kene kew egpalintutuu te insulat din, sikan naa ka kene kew degma egpalintutuu te iglalag ku kaniyu.”

41 “I don't caused_ myself _to_be_praised by the people. 42 But I know you(pl) on_the_contrary and I know that the love of God is not in your(pl) hearts. 43 I came carrying the authority of my Father, but I wasn't accepted by you(pl). And if someone else comes in his/her own authority, you(pl) accept him/her/it. 44 How can you(pl) believe if you(pl) just want to praise_each_other, but you(pl) ignore the praise from the one_and_only God. 45 But don't(pl) think that I will_accuse you(pl) to my Father. Muwisis himself who you(pl) hope in will_accuse you(pl). 46 If it was true that you(pl) believed Muwisis, you(pl) would have also believed me because he himself is the (one who) wrote about me. 47 But since you(pl) don't believe what he wrote, that's why you(pl) also don't believe what_ I _tell you(pl).”

Ka pegpakeen ni Hisus te 5,000 ne me etew

The feeding of Jesus with 5,000 people

(Mat 14:13‑21; Mar 6:30‑44; Luk 9:10‑17)

(Mat 14:13‑21; Mar 6:30‑44; Luk 9:10‑17)

61 Pegkapenga dutu, miglapas e man-e ensi Hisus diye te Lanew te Galiliya ne egngaranan degma te Lanew te Tibiryas. 2 Amana ne masalig ne me etew ka migsinsinundul engki Hisus su nakakita sikandan te me kein-inuwan ne inggimu rin te pegpamawi din te egmanderalu. 3 Ne migpatakereg e ensi Hisus duma te me hibateen din diye te bubungan wey diye migpinpinnuu. 4 Te seeye ne timpu, mahaan e man-e ka Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan te Manama. 5 Te pegtengteng ni Hisus, nakita rin ka susuluhi ne me etew ne egpeendiye te kandan. Ne migkahiyan din si Pilipi, “Hendei ki egpakabebeli te egkakeen ne igpakeen ta te seini ne me etew?” 6 (Inlalag din sika eyew te peg-eleg-eleg ki Pilipi, kunaleg te tapey e sikandin nakanengneng ke nekey ka eggimuwen din.)

61 When that was_finished, Jesus and_company crossed again the Lake of Galiliya also called the Lake of Tibiryas. 2 Very many people followed Jesus and_company because they saw he did wonders healing(pl) the sick(pl). 3 Jesus and his disciples climbed the mountain and sat_down there. 4 At that time, the Feast of the Passing of the Angel of God was close again. 5 As Jesus looked, he saw the great_many people coming to him. And he said to Pilipi, “Where can we(incl) buy food to feed these people?” 6 (He said that because he was testing Pilipi, but he knew in advance what he would do.)

7 Ne migtabak si Pilipi, “Minsan pad ke egbebeli ki te paan ne bali te daruwa ne gatus (200) ne dinaryu,[fn] wey egdereiseken te re te pegpamehey, kene de egkakeenan ka seini ne me etew.”

7 And Pilipi answered, “Even if we(incl) buy bread worth two-hundred (200) dinariyu,[fn] and we(incl) will_give little_to_each, these people just couldn't (all) eat.”

(Mat 14:22‑33; Mar 6:45‑52)

(Mat 14:22‑33; Mar 6:45‑52)

16 Ne hengkayi se egpangilum-kilum e, nanupang e ka me hibateen din diye te lanew 17 wey nanguntud te balangey ka eglapas diye te Kapirnaum. 16 And when it was getting_dark, the disciples of Jesus descended to the lake 17 and rode a boat to cross to Kapirnaum. And it got dark then, Jesus hadn't yet followed them. 18 While they were crossing, the wind_blew strongly and the waves grew. 19 When they had rowed about five or six kilometers, they saw Jesus walking on the water coming towards their boat, and they were_afraid. 20 But Jesus said to them, “Don't(pl) be_afraid because this is me.” 21 And there, they wanted Jesus to ride on the boat, and suddenly they arrived at their destination.

35 Ne migkahiyan ni Hisus sikandan, “Sikeddiey ka keenen ne egbehey te umul. Ka egparani keddi kenad iya eggutasan, wey ka egpalintutuu wey egsalig keddi, kenad egkammaraan. 36 Piru iling te nakahi kud e kaniyu ne minsan nakita ad nikaniyu, kene kew red iya man-e egpalintutuu. 37 Ka langun ne etew ne igbehey te Amey ku keddi, egparani keddiey. The one who comes_near to me will_ indeed no_longer _be_hungry, and the (one who) believes and trusts me, will_ no_longer _be_thirsty. 36 But it's like what_ I _told you(pl) that even_though you(pl) have_seen me, you(pl) indeed just don't believe. 37 All the people that my Father gives me, come_near to me. Ka Sahakeen te me Balungbalung

10 Te nangipanew e ka me suled ni Hisus peendiye te sahakeen, migsinundul e degma si Hisus piru ware migpeeyang-heyang. 11 Ne impamitew sikandin te me pangulu te me Hudiyu diye te sahakeen wey nanginse sikandan ke hendeid e sikandin.

Piru ka etew ne iyan igpabantug ka migsuhu kandin, egkapalintutuuwan wey kene ne ubaten. 19 Imbehayan kew ni Muwisis te Balaud te Manama, menu ma iya? 16 So then, Jesus answered them, “My teaching, is not from me, but rather, from God who sent/commanded me. 17 Anyone who wants to do what God desires, knows whether my teaching is from God or just from my own self. 18 The person who speaks from his own thoughts, is causing_ himself _to_be_famous. 21 Ne migtabak si Hisus, “Duen de inggimu ku te Aldew te Peggimeley wey neinu-inu kew e langun 22 [xra][xrb]minsan nekeg-iling ki re iya. Su due impanulu ni Muwisis kaniyu ne pegtuli te me anak niyu (minsan kene ne diye egbunsud sika te ki Muwisis su diye te kaap-apuan din), ne inggimu niyu sika minsan ke Aldew te Peggimeley. 23 [xr]Ke egtulien niyu ka sabeka ne bate te Aldew te Peggimeley eyew te pegtuman te Balaud ni Muwisis, ne mania te nabelu kew keddi te imbawian ku ka sabeka ne etew te Aldew te Peggimeley? 24 Kene niyu hukumi ka etew pinaahi te egkakita niyu ne hinimuwan din, ke kene, hukumi niyu sikandin pinaahi te eleg ne gantangan wey palabian.”

81 Ne si Hisus mule, miggendiye sikandin te Bubungan te Ulibu. 2 Te pegkapawe, migselem-selem e man-e si Hisus miggendiye te timplu. Piru ware kew nataha ke hendei a migpuun wey ke hendei a eggendiye. 15 Ka peggukum niyu puun de te suman-suman niyu, piru sikeddiey mule, wara a miggukum te minsan hentew. 16 Piru ke eggukum e ma, eleg mule ka peggukum ku su kene ne sikeddi de ka eggukum, ke kene, daruwa ney te Amey ne migpeendini keddi. 17 [xr]Nasulat diye te Balaud niyu ne emun ke egpekeg-iling ka guhuren te daruwa ne talagpamalehet, malehet naa ka guhuren dan. 18 Mig-uney-uney a migpamalehet meyitenged keddiey, wey migpamalehet degma meyitenged keddi ka Amey ne migsuhu keddi.”

Ne miglagpu mule si Lasaru ki Hisus te egkeen diye te lamisa. 3 [xr]Nataman, migkuwa si Mariya te liware te litru ne peemut ne mahal ne nardu, wey mig-itisan din ka paa ni Hisus, wey impunasan din man-e te bulbul din. Ne migsekel de iya te baley ka keemut te peemut. 4 Piru migkahi si Hudas Iskaryuti ne sabeka te me hibateen ni Hisus ne iyan ka eg-eakal kandin, 5 “Mania te ware ibelegye seini se peemut te tatelu ne gatus (300) ne dinaryu,[fn] ne ka halin, igpamehey e diye te egkengaayu-ayu?” 6 Inlalag din seini, kene ne puun su neyid-u sikandin te egkaayu-ayu, ke kene, puun su takawen sikandin. Sikandin nahud ka egpeuy-uyanen te puntil ne tahuanan te seleppi, wey nalayam sikandin ne egkuwa te seleppi diye te puntil.

121 Just six days before the Feast of the Passing of the Angel of God, Jesus went to Bitanya where Lasaru lived who he had raised from the dead. 2 They cooked supper for him, and Marta was serving_out the food. And Lasaru ate on_the_contrary with Jesus at the table. 3 [xr]Then, Mariya took half a liter of expensive nard (BORROWED nardu) perfume, and she poured it on the leg(s)/feet of Jesus, and she also wiped it with her hair. And the fragrance of the perfume really filled the house. 4 But Hudas Iskariyuti who was one of the disciples of Jesus that would_betray him said, 5 “Why wasn't this perfume sold for three hundred (300) dinariyus,[fn] and the profit, be distributed to the poor?” 6 He said this, not because he was compassionate for the poor, but rather, because he was a thief. He (was) the (one who) was_asked_to_carry the purse where money was kept, and he was used to taking money from the purse.

7 Piru migkahi si Hisus, “Balahara nu re due sikandin, wey kene nu balabahi ne igtahahe seini te aldew te pegsabal keddi. 8 [xr]Su ka egkengaayu-ayu, layun niyu mule egkaruma, piru sikeddi, kena a nikaniyu layun egkaruma.”

7 But Jesus said, “Leave her alone, and don't prohibit her to reserve this for the day of my wrapping_and_storing. 8 [xr]Because the poor, (they) on_the_contrary will_ always _accompany you(pl), but as for me, I won't always accompany you(pl).”

Ka planu te peggimatey ki Lasaru

The plan to kill Lasaru

9 Due masalig ne me Hudiyu ne miggendiye te ki Hisus te pegkarineg dan te diye sikandin te Bitanya. Miggendiye sikandan, kene ne tenged de ki Hisus, ke kene, eyew egpitew degma ki Lasaru te in-uyag din ka migpatey. 10 Seeye naa, imbentaanan e degma te me pangulu te talagpanubad ne eggimatayan dan si Lasaru, 11 su tenged kandin, masalig ka me Hudiyu ne nangawe diye kandan wey migpalintutuu wey migsalig e ki Hisus.

9 There were many Hudiyus that went to Jesus when they heard that he was there in Bitanya. They went there, not just (for) Jesus, but rather, also to see Lasaru whom he had raised when (he) died. 10 And from that, the leaders of the sacrificer(s) also planned to kill Lasaru, 11 since because of him, many Hudiyus left them and believe and trust in Jesus.

20 Due duma ne me Grigu ne miggendiye te Hirusalim eyew te pegsimba te Manama te timpu te sahakeen. 21 Ne migparani sikandan ki Pilipi ne matig-Bitsayda ne sakup te Galiliya, wey migkahiyan dan sikandin, “Ahalen, egkeupian key ne egpakigkita ki Hisus.”

20 There were some Grigus who went to Hirusalim in_order to worship God at the time of the feast. 21 They approached Pilipi from Bitsayda under_Galiliya, and they said to him, “Master, we(excl) would like to see Jesus.”

22 Mignangenan ni Pilipi si Andris, wey migparumeey sikandan se daruwa ka miggendiye ki Hisus eyew egnangen kandin. 23 Ne migtabak si Hisus, “Miggingume e kuntee ka timpu ne egmabantug ka Anak te Etew. 24 Egnangenan ku sikaniyu te malehet: ka sabeka ne beni te trigu ne kene iglebeng te tane, egkeyimu ne sabeka re iya ne beni. Piru ke iglebeng wey egpatey, egtubu seeye wey egbebehas te masalig. 25 [xr]Seeye se amana eggeyinawa te kandin ne umul, nasi egkawarei kayi, piru seeye se kene egkannuhun te kandin ne umul, egpakaangken te umul ne ware egtamanan. 26 Minsan hentew ne egpamakey keddi, keilangan ne eg-ikul keddi eyew ke hendei a, diye degma ka suluhuanen ku. Ka etew ne egpamakey keddi, eggimuwen ne mabantug te Amey ku.”

22 Pilipi told Andris, and those two went_together to Jesus to tell him. 23 And Jesus answered, “The time has arrived now when the Child of a Person will_become_great. 24 I tell you(pl) the truth: one seed of wheat that is not buried in the soil, will_ just _be_indeed one seed. But if (it) is buried and dies, it will_sprout and bear lots. 25 [xr]Those who loves his/her life very much, will_lose it, but those who's not possessive about his/her life, will_receive life without ending. 26 Whoever serves me, needs to follow me so_that wherever I am, there also will my servant be. The person who serves me, will_be_given honor by my Father.”

27 Ne migkahi pad man-e si Hisus, “Due igkabantali ku seini. Nekey buwa ka iglalag ku? Egkahiyan ku buwa ka Amey ku te kene e re egpabaybayaran? No, because that's why_ I really _came, to suffer difficulties in this time.” 28 And he said to his Father, “Father, show(sg) your(sg) strength/splendor so_that your(sg) name will_be_made_great!”

Seinid iya ka timpu ne egdeldelen e si Meibulan\f + \fr 12:31 \ft Te Grigu: talagmandu.\f* ne iyan migmandu kuntee kayi te ampew te tane. 32 Due timpu keureme ne egkayawen ad puun te tane,\f + \fr 12:32 \ft Ka igpasabut te egkayawen, ka pegpasasindeg e te krus ne inlansangan kandin wey ka pegbatun kandin.\f* wey egpeparaniyen ku ka langun ne etew kayi te keddiey.” 33 (Inlalag din seini eyew te pegpasabut kandan ke nekey ne klasi te kapatayan ka egpangkusan din.)

30 But Jesus said to them, “That voice was_made_ for you(pl) _to_hear, it wasn't me that it_was_made_to_hear. 31 This is indeed the time that the people here on top of the earth will_be_judged. This is indeed the time that Satan\f + \fr 12:31 \ft In Greek: ruler.\f* that rules here on top of the ground will_be_driven_away. 32 There will_be_a future time when I am lifted up from the earth,\f + \fr 12:32 \ft The meaning of lifted_up, (is) the standing_up of the cross on which he was nailed and his ascension.\f* and I will_cause_ all people _to_come_near to me.” 33 (He said this to explain them what kind of death that he would undergo.)

Te pegkapenga rin dutu te miglalag, miggipanew e sikandin wey miggeles kandan.37 Minsan masalig e ka me kein-inuwan ne neyimu rin diye te tangkaan dan, piru ware pad iya man-e sikandan migpalintutuu wey migsalig kandin. 38 [xr]Seini ka migpamalehet te ingkahi ni prupita Isayas ne eggenendue:

Ka lalag ni Hisus ka eggukum

The word of Jesus which will_judge

44 Nataman, migbalbalukan si Hisus ka miglalag ne eggenendue, “Ka egpalintutuu wey egsalig keddiey, kene de ne sikeddi ka egpalintutuuwan wey egsalihan din, ke kene, minsan degma ka migsuhu keddiey. 45 Ka nakakita keddi, nakakita degma te migsuhu keddi. 46 Miggendini a kayi te ampew te tane isip kalayag, su eyew minsan hentew ne egpalintutuu wey egsalig keddi, kene egkahaat diye te marusilem. 47 Ke due egpakarineg te iglalag ku wey kene egtuman kayi, kene ku sikandin eggukuman. Su wara a miggendini te ampew te tane eyew te peggukum, ke kene, eyew te pegluwas te me etew. 48 Seeye se egsamsamili keddi wey eggubabe te iglalag ku, seini iya se igpangguhud ku ka eggukum kandin te katammanan ne aldew! 49 Su wara a mig-uney-uney migpangguhud te keddi de ne guhuren, ke kene, ka igpepangguhud te Amey ne migpeendini keddiey ka iglalag ku wey igpangguhud ku. 50 Ne nakanengneng a ne ka suhu din, egpakabehey te umul ne ware egtamanan. Purisu, ka inlalag ku, impalalag naa sika keddiey te Amey.”

44 Then, Jesus spoke loudly like this, “Whoever believes and trusts in me, he doesn't believe and trust just in me, but rather, even to the one_who_sent/commanded me. 45 Whoever sees me, also sees the one_who_sent/commanded me. 46 I came here on the top of the ground as light, so_that whoever believes and trusts in me, won't be left_behind in darkness. 47 If anyone who hears what_ I _say but doesn't obey it, I won't judge him/her. Because I didn't come here on top of the groun to judge, but rather, to save the people. 48 Those who reject/deny me and disbelieve what_ I _say, this indeed what_ I _am_saying will_judge him in the final day! 49 Because I didn't personally tell my own story, but rather, what_ I _said and what_ I _told is just what_caused_to_be_said by the Father who sent_ me _here. 50 And I know that his command, can_give life without ending. Therefore, what_ I _said, was caused_to_be_said by me by the Father.”

Ka pegpanlu-lu ni Hisus te paa te me hibateen din

The washing of Jesus of his disciples' feet/legs

131 Te ware pad migginguma ka aldew te Sahakeen te Peglihad te Panalihan te Manama, tapey e nataheyi ni Hisus ne miggingume e ka timpu ne eg-awe e sikandin kayi te ampew te tane wey eglibed e diye te Amey. Miggeyinawaan din amana seeye se migpamakey kandin kayi te ampew te tane, wey igpapitew rin ka geyinawa rin taman te katamanan.

131 Before the day of the Feast of the Passing of the Angel of God arrived, Jesus already knew that the time had come when he would leave here on top of the ground and return to the Father. He really loved those who served him here on top of the ground, and he will_show his love until the end.

2 Te peglabung e enni Hisus te me hibateen din, impasuman-suman e ni Meibulan si Hudas ne anak ni Simun Iskaryuti meyitenged te peg-akal ki Hisus. 3 Nanengnengan ni Hisus ne due katenged din te minsan nekey, su imbehey seini te Amey diye te kandin. Ne nanengnengan din man-e ne diye din egpuun te Manama wey eglibed din ded man-e diye te kandin. 4 Seeye naa, migsasindeg sikandin diye te keenanan wey migluluung te ingkukuyumbu din wey miglilibed te tualya. 5 Ne mig-itisan din te weyig ka pelenggana wey impanlu-luan din ka me paa te me hibateen din wey impamunasan din man-e te tualya ne inlilibed din. 6 Te neumaan din e si Simun Pidru, migkahi e si Simun, “Magbebaye, eglu-luan nu ka paa ku?”

2 At the time when Jesus and his disciples were having_supper, Hudas the child of Simun Iskariyuti was caused_to_think by Satan about betraying Jesus. 3 Jesus knew that he had authority over everything, because this was_given to him by the Father. And he also knew that he had come there from God and (that) he would just return there again to him. 4 And so, he stood up at the eating_place and removed his wrapped_covering and wrapped_ a towel _around. 5 Then he poured water into a basin and washed the feet/legs of his disciples and wiped them also with the towel he wrapped_around. 6 When he reached Simun Pidru, Simun then said, “Lord, will_ you(sg) _wash my feet/legs?”

7 Ne migtabak si Hisus, “Kuntee, kene nu pad egkasabut ka eggimuwen ku, piru wey nud e seini egkasabut.”

7 And Jesus answered, “Now/Today, you(sg) won't understand what_ I _am doing, but you(sg) will_understand this in_the_future.”

8 Ne migkahi si Pidru, “Kena ad iya egpalu-lu keykew te paa ku te minsan ken-u!”

8 And Pidru said, “I won't get_ you(sg) to _wash my feet/legs at any time!”

Piru migtabak si Hisus, “Ke kene ka egpalu-lu te paa nu, kene kud e ne hibateen sikeykew!”

But Jesus answered, “If I don't wash your(sg) feet/legs, you(sg) will_ no_longer _be my disciple!”

9 Ne migkahi si Pidru, “Ke iling ma rue Magbebaye, kene de ne paa lu-lui nu su ilagkes nud degma ka ulu ku wey ka belad ku!”

9 And Pidru said, “If it's like that Lord, don't just wash my feet/legs because include also my head and my hands/arms!”

10 Piru migkahi si Hisus, “Ka nakapamanihus e, malinis e wey kenad ne keilangan ne egpanlu-lu pad. Paa rin naan de ka eglu-luan. Sikaniyu langun, malinis e, angin e te sabeka ne duma niyu.” 11 (Tapey e ne nanengnengan ni Hisus ke hentew ka eg-akal kandin, purisu migkahi sikandin, “Sikaniyu langun, malinis e, angin te sabeka ne duma niyu.”)

10 But Jesus said, “The one_who_has_bathed, is already clean and doesn't still need to wash. Only his feet must be washed. You(pl) all, are clean already, except for one among you(pl).” 11 (Jesus knew in_advance who would_betray him, therefore he said, “You(pl) all, are clean already, except for one who is your(pl) companion.”)

12 [xr]Te pegkapenga rin te miglu-lu te me paa ran, insaluub din e man-e ka ingkukuyumbu din wey miglibed diye te keenanan. Nataman, mig-insaan din e sikandan, “Nakasabut kew red te inggimu ku kaniyu? 13 Migngaranan a nikaniyu te Talagpanulu wey Magbebaye, wey eleg iya sika, su malehet iya ne sikan a iya. 14 Ne emun ke migpanlu-luan ku ka me paa niyu te Magbebaye wey Talagpanulu e ma perem nikaniyu, eleg de iya ne egmalu-luey kew degma te me paa niyu. 15 Inggimu ku sika isip panunggilingan eyew eg-ilingan niyu ka inggimu ku kaniyu. 16 [xr]Egnangenan ku sikaniyu te malehet: ware uripen ne labew te kandin ne ahalen, ne ware degma insuhu ne labew te migsuhu kandin. 17 Ne kuntee te nakataha kew e te kamalehetan, egpanalanginan kew ke eggimuwen niyu seini!

12 [xr]When he had_finished washing their feet/legs, he put back on his wrapping/cloak and returned to the eating place. Then, he asked, “Do you(pl) understand what_ I _did to you(pl)? 13 You(pl) called me Teacher and Lord, and that is correct, because it is indeed correct that I am that. 14 If I washed your(pl) feet/legs even if I (am) your(pl) Lord and Teacher, it is also correct that you(pl) wash_each_others feet/legs. 15 I did that as an example so_that you(pl) will_do what_ I _did to you(pl). 16 [xr]I tell you(pl) the truth: there's_no slave greater than his master, and also no one who's commanded is greater than the one_who_commanded him/her. 17 And now/today that you(pl) know the truth, you(pl) will_be_blessed if you(pl) do this!

18 [xr]“Kene ne sikaniyu langun ka egkahiyen ku ne egpanalanginan, su nekeila a te in-alam ku. Piru keilangan ne egkatuman ka nasulat te Kasulatan ne eggenendue, ‘Ka etew ne migpakigtuhen keddi, iyan egkuntere keddi.’ 19 Egpanpanayan kud sikaniyu eglalahan meyitenged kayi te ware pad seini neyitabu eyew ke egkeyitabu e seini, egpakapalintutuu kew ne ‘Sikeddi iya sikandin.’ 20 [xr]Egnangenan ku sikaniyu te malehet: ka minsan hentew ne egdawat te me etew ne migsuhu ku, egdawat degma keddiey, ne ka egdawat keddi, egdawat degma te migsuhu keddi.”

18 [xr]“It's not you(pl) all that I'm talking_to who will_be_blessed, because I recognize (who) I have_chosen. But it's_necessary that what's_written in the Writings be_fulfilled that goes, ‘The person who eats_together with me, will_oppose me.’ 19 I've told you(pl) this before it happens so_that if/when it happens, you(pl) will_believe that ‘I am he.’ 20 [xr]I tell you(pl) the truth: Whoever accepts people whom I send/command, also accepts me, and the (one who) accepts me, also accepts the one_who_sent/commanded me.”

(Mat 26:20‑25; Mar 14:17‑21; Luk 22:21‑23)

(Mat 26:20‑25; Mar 14:17‑21; Luk 22:21‑23)

Ka himu te Panisingan te Manama

The work of the Spirit of God

“Ware ku ilalag seini te an-anayan su dume e mem pad kaniyu.5 Piru kuntee, eglibed ad e diye te migsuhu keddi, ne warad iya minsan sabeka kaniyu ne mig-inse ke hendei a eggendiye. 6 Ne kuntee te ingkahiyan kud sikaniyu, nalaggew kew e amana. 7 Piru egnangenan ku sikaniyu te malehet: egpakameupiya kaniyu ne eg-awa a kayi su emun ke kene, kene eggendini te kaniyu ka Talagpangabang. “I didn't say this at first because I was still with you(pl).5 But now, I am_returning to the one_who_sent/commanded me, and not one of you(pl) asks where I am going. 6 And now that I have told you(pl), you(pl) are very sad. 7 But I tell you(pl) the truth: it_will_be_good for you(pl) if I leave here because if not, the Helper won't come_here to you(pl). (Mat 26:47‑56; Mar 14:43‑50; Luk 22:47‑53)

(Mat 27:32‑44; Mar 15:21‑32; Luk 23:26‑43)

(Mat 27:32‑44; Mar 15:21‑32; Luk 23:26‑43)

Purisu in-uyan dan e si Hisus,17 wey miglihawang sikandan te siyudad. And it was_written in Hibruwanon, Latin, and Greek languages. 21 And the leaders of the sacrificer(s) of the Hudiyus said to Pilatu, “Don't(sg) write ‘King of the Hudiyus’, but rather, ‘This person said he was (hearsay) the king of the Hudiyus.’ ”

31 Aldew seeye te pegpangandam te Peggimeley. Ne kene egkeupian ka me pangulu te me Hudiyu ne egkahaat diye te krus ka me lawa te me minatey tenged su ka seup ne aldew, Aldew e te Peggimeley ne amana ne impurtanti diye te me Hudiyu. Purisu mighangyu sikandan ki Pilatu ke egkaayun ne egpanggepuen ka me paa te me etew ne inlansang te krus eyew mahaan egpatey wey eg-aween e. 32 Purisu nangendiye ka me sundalu wey impanggepu dan ka me paa te daruwa ne etew ne inlansang duma ki Hisus. 33 Piru te pegginguma ran diye te ki Hisus, nakita ran ne migpatey e sikandin, purisu ware dan e gepua ka paa rin. 34 Piru ka sabeka te me sundalu, impilak din te deldeg din ka kakiliran ni Hisus, wey due-rue ne migtihis ka langesa wey weyig. 35 (Malehet seini ne neyitabu su due nakakita kayi, wey migpamalehetan din seini. Nakanengneng sikandin te malehet ka guhuren din, wey ingguhud din seini eyew egpalintutuu kew degma.) 36 [xr]Neyitabu seini su eyew egkatuman ka nasulat diye te Kasulatan ne eggenendue, “Ware minsan sabeka ne tul-an din ne egkahepu.” 37 [xr]Ne duen pad man-e nasulat diye te Kasulatan ne eggenendue, “Egtengtengan dan ka etew ne impilak dan.”

31 That was the day of preparation of Resting. And the leaders of the Hudiyus didn't want the bodies of the dead to remain there on the cross because the next day, was the Day of Resting that's very important to the Hudiyus. Therefore they requested Pilatu if it would_be_possible to break the legs of the people nailed to the cross so_that they would quickly die and could be removed. 32 Therefore the soldiers went_there and broke the legs of the two persons that was nailed with Jesus. 33 But upon their arrival at Jesus, they saw that he was already dead, therefore they didn't break his leg(s). 34 But one of the soldiers, he pierced the side of Jesus with his spear, and immediately the blood and water poured_out. 35 (This that happened was true because someone saw it, and he proved/confirmed it. He knew that what he said is correct, and he tell it so_that you(pl) will_believe also.) 36 [xr]This happened so_that what the Scriptures say would_be_fulfilled like this, “Not even one of his bones will_be_broken.” 37 [xr]And there_is also (something) in the Scriptures that was_written saying, “They will_look at the person they pierced.”

The wrapping_and_storing_of_the_body of Jesus

(Mat 27:57‑61; Mar 15:42‑47; Luk 23:50‑56)

(Mat 27:57‑61; Mar 15:42‑47; Luk 23:50‑56)

38 Te pegkapenga kayi, imbuyu e ni Husi ne matig-Arimatiya ka lawa ni Hisus diye te ki Pilatu. (Si Husi, sabeka ne hibateen ni Hisus piru te heles de su egkaaldek sikandin te me pangulu te me Hudiyu.) Ne intuhutan ni Pilatu si Husi, purisu miggendiye sikandin wey ingkuwa rin e ka lawa ni Hisus. 39 [xr]Migduma degma kandin si Nikudimu, ka migpakigkita ki Hisus te sabeka ne marusilem. Mig-uyan sikandin te peemut ne me lalimma ne pulu (50) ne kilu ne migsewuhan te mira wey aluyi. 40 Nataman, migkuwa ran e te daruwa ka lawa ni Hisus wey imbukusan dan te hinabel ne migtahuan te peemut. Seini ka batasan te me Hudiyu ke eglebeng te minatey. 41 Ne due sabeka ne pamulaan ne diye te miglansangan ki Hisus, wey due iyam pad ne sabalanan ne ware pad nasabali. 42 Ne puun su Aldew e seeye te Pegpangandam te Peggimeley te me Hudiyu, wey marani re degma ka sabalanan, diye dan e isabal ka lawa ni Hisus.

38 When this was_finished, Husi from Arimatiya requested the body of Jesus from Pilatu. (Husi, was a disciple of Jesus but secretly because he was afraid of the leaders of the Hudiyus.) And Pilatu allowed Husi, therefore he went and he took the body of Jesus. 39 [xr]Nikudimu also accompanied him, that one who met with Jesus one night. He took about fifty (50) kilograms of perfumes with mira and aluwi in it. 40 Then, the two of them took the body of Jesus and wrapped it with woven_cloth and with perfume on it. This was the custom of the Hudiyus when burying a dead_body. 41 And there_was a garden there where Jesus was nailed, and there_was a new burial_storage_place where no one had yet been_wrapped_and_stored. 42 And because it was the Day of Preparing for Resting of the Hudiyus, and also the corpse_laying_out place was just close, they laid_out_the_corpse the body of Jesus there.

7 And that disciple who was loved by Jesus said to Pidru, “That's the Lord!” When Simun Pidru heard that it was the Lord, he dressed in clothing that he stripped and he swam to get_out_of_the_water. 8 The other disciples on_the_contrary, (they) still rode the boat and came_to_the_edge of the lake pulling the net that was full of game. 22 Ne migtabak si Hisus, “Emun ke igkeupii ku ne kene sikandin egpatey taman te peglibed ku, nekey ma ka labet nu? Ikul ke re keddi!”

22 And Jesus answered like this, “If I want that he shouldn't die until my return, what is that to you(sg)? Just follow me!”

23 Purisu nekeempet ka guhuren diye te migmalintutuu ki Hisus ne kene egpatey ka seeye ne hibateen. Piru ware migkahi si Hisus ne ka seeye ne hibateen, kene egpatey, ke kene, migkahi re sikandin, “Emun ke igkeupii ku ne kene egpatey sikandin taman te peglibed ku, nekey ma ka labet nu?”

23 Therefore the story spread to the believers of Jesus that that disciple wouldn't die. But Jesus never said that that disciple, wouldn't die, but rather, he just said that, “If I want that he shouldn't die until me return, what is that to you(sg)?”

24 Ne sikandin iya ka hibateen ne migpamalehet ne malehet ka langun, wey sikandin iya ka migsusulat kayi. Ne nakanengneng key te malehet ka ingkahi rin.

24 And he indeed was the disciple who witnessed/proved that all is correct, and he indeed is the (one who) wrote this. And we(excl) know that was he said was true.

Ka katammanan

Ending

25 Masalig pad amana ka neyimu ni Hisus ne emun ke ig-amin igsulat, kene buwa eg-eleg kayi te ampew te tane ka me libru ne egkasulatan.

25 Jesus did very much more and if it was entirely written, the books which it would_be_written_in probably wouldn't fit here on top of the ground.
